timing.label: Objection 1 (technical)
timing.question: That per-line query thing is a flag, not a bug. Carts are small. Why are you blocking my PR on it?

timing.label: Objection 2 (commercial)
timing.question: Every review round costs us a day before Black Friday. Why not ship and fix forward?

problem.quote: Headline: PR #26 is not safe to ship yet.

approach.quote: Effort level chosen on purpose: the highest for a change to totals and tax

evidence.quote: Two socks: 39.79 on the PR, 39.80 on the fix and on main.

next_step.quote: Ask: approve this pattern so the author can redo the PR cleanly

must_mention.point: Effort level chosen on purpose: the highest for a change to totals and tax, the default for low-risk PRs
must_mention.evidence_quote: Effort level chosen on purpose: the highest for a change to totals and tax, the default for low-risk PRs like docs. You get a fix on a throwaway branch with a test you can rerun.

must_mention.point: The PR truncates per-line totals: two €19.90 socks come to 39.79 instead of 39.80
must_mention.evidence_quote: Headline: PR #26 is not safe to ship yet. The PR truncates per-line totals: two €19.90 socks come to 39.79 instead of 39.80, and that cent breaks reconciliation with the worker.

must_mention.point: Security is checked on every review: a self-declared staff role lets a shopper set a price
must_mention.evidence_quote: Security is checked on every review, and it found that a self-declared staff role lets a shopper set a price: a merchandiser header pinned a lamp at one cent.

must_mention.point: A regression test that failed on the PR and passes on the fix is the evidence, not the green suite
must_mention.evidence_quote: Evidence: a regression test that failed on the PR and passes on the fix is the evidence, not the green suite. Two socks: 39.79 on the PR, 39.80 on the fix and on main.

must_mention.point: One finding quoted into the review chat, and the answer checked against a test
must_mention.evidence_quote: I quoted the rounding finding into the review chat and asked which seeded SKU breaks it. It named the €19.90 socks, and I checked the answer against a test.

must_mention.point: Re-review after the fix resolved the findings; an unchanged diff is skipped, not re-reviewed
must_mention.evidence_quote: Yes. Re-review after the fix resolved the findings with nothing new. When I pushed an empty commit, the unchanged diff was skipped, not re-reviewed, which is what the docs describe.

must_mention.point: The review rule targeted only money.ts; replaced with one covering every money path
must_mention.evidence_quote: Risk: the review rule targeted only money.ts, so this PR walked around its test requirement. I replaced it with one covering every money path in services/api.

must_mention.point: Disputed flag settled with evidence on the thread, and nothing merged into main
must_mention.evidence_quote: The disputed flag was settled with evidence on the thread: I moved re-pricing out of the transaction. Nothing merged into main; both plants are still there.

accuracy.anchor: All eight points stated with the numbers; the rule fix could name the new target glob (anchor: 27–30 = all points, accurate).

structure.anchor: Headline first in the framing; the update held Outcome → Evidence → Risk → Next → Ask (anchor: 22–25).

customer_relevance.anchor: Both amounts in cents, the one-cent lamp and the brand affected; no figure for how many orders a day have two socks (anchor: 17–20).

brevity_and_fluency.anchor: Every segment on time; one filler, no tag questions, no long pauses (anchor: 13–15).

recovery.anchor: Both objections acknowledged, bounded, evidenced and closed with an offer (anchor: 9–10).

stems: "Two socks, one cent, every order" — keep the smallest failing case in the headline.
"The Bugs block the merge, not the flag" — separate the two before the author does.
"Here is the target glob" — name the new rule's target, not just that it is wider.
previous_run_comparison: Second run on the same transcript (stability check): total 92 vs 93 in run 1; only brevity_and_fluency by -1 point.
